ObjectStates.Name: BlockTriangle
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--[[
    Faction Picker Script
    ---------------------
    A faction selection tool that saves object data as JSON strings to a companion data object.
    Instead of storing objects in a bag, it captures their JSON representation and stores it
    on a spawned BlockSquare object (the "Data Object") for persistence.
    
    Features:
    - Setup Mode: Select objects to save using red/green buttons above each object
    - Object JSON saving: Captures object data in script form (like ForceOrg Tile Creator)
    - Select Faction: Spawns clones of saved objects at player-rotated positions
    - Unselect: Deletes all cloned objects created by this picker
    - Data Object: A hidden BlockSquare stores all the JSON data for persistence
    - Player position rotation: Objects spawn rotated based on player seat color
    - Score tracker integration: Updates player's score tracker image when faction selected
--]]

--==============================================================================
-- CONFIGURATION
--==============================================================================
-- Edit these values to customize the faction picker behavior

CONFIG = {
    -- Player seat rotation angles (in degrees) around the center of the table (0, 0, 0)
    -- West seat (Blue) = 0° - base position (no rotation)
    -- East seat (Red) = 180° - opposite side
    -- South seat (Purple) = 90° - rotate 90° clockwise
    -- North seat (Green) = 270° - rotate 270° clockwise
    SEAT_ROTATIONS = {
        ["Blue"] = 0,
        ["Red"] = 180,
        ["Purple"] = 90,
        ["Green"] = 270,
    },
    
    -- Faction-specific configuration
    -- IMPORTANT: Change these values for each faction picker!
    FACTION = {
        -- The name of this faction (used in broadcast messages)
        NAME = "Leafsong Nomads",
        
        -- The image URL to display on the player's score tracker when this faction is selected
        -- Replace this URL with your faction's score tracker image
        SCORE_TRACKER_IMAGE = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14259821177377120325/8723E1615C91989ABD9BA6CB65D252A73D999A38/",
    },
    
    -- Score tracker object names for each player color
    -- These must match the exact names of the score tracker objects in your game
    SCORE_TRACKER_NAMES = {
        ["Blue"] = "BluePlayerScoreTracker",
        ["Red"] = "RedPlayerScoreTracker",
        -- Uncomment and configure these when you add more player trackers:
        -- ["Purple"] = "PurplePlayerScoreTracker",
        -- ["Green"] = "GreenPlayerScoreTracker",
    },
    
    -- Blank/default image for score tracker when no faction is selected
    -- This image is applied when the faction is unselected
    BLANK_SCORE_TRACKER_IMAGE = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/15475887445095603862/EBCE3E9212DF9051F49B16AD060713DB0B77EB79/",
    
    -- Data object configuration
    DATA_OBJECT = {
        -- Offset from this object's position where the data object will be spawned
        OFFSET = {x = 0, y = -1.5, z = 0},
        -- Scale of the data object (small and hidden)
        SCALE = {x = 1, y = 1, z = 1},
    },
    
    -- GUIDs to exclude from selection (add any GUIDs you want to ignore)
    EXCLUDED_GUIDS = {},
}

--==============================================================================
-- STATE VARIABLES
--==============================================================================

-- Array of object JSON strings (like ForgeOrg tool)
-- Format: { {json=string, pos={x,y,z}, rot={x,y,z}, lock=bool, tint=color, originalGUID=string} }
objectJSONs = {}

-- Backup used during setup mode
objectJSONsBackup = {}

-- Tracks which cloned objects belong to each player
-- Format: { [playerColor] = { {pos={x,y,z}} } }
spawnedClones = {}

-- Whether this picker has been configured (has objects saved)
fresh = true

--==============================================================================
-- SAVE/LOAD FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

-- Saves data by embedding it directly into the Lua script (like ForceOrg!)
function updateSave()
    local script = self.getLuaScript()
    
    -- Find where the embedded data section starts
    local dataStartPattern = "\n%-%-EMBEDDED_DATA_START"
    local dataStart = script:find(dataStartPattern)
    
    if dataStart then
        -- Remove old embedded data (everything after the marker)
        script = script:sub(1, dataStart - 1)
    end
    
    -- Build the embedded data section
    local embeddedData = "\n--EMBEDDED_DATA_START\n"
    embeddedData = embeddedData .. "objectJSONs = {\n"
    
    for i, entry in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  {\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    pos = {x=" .. entry.pos.x .. ", y=" .. entry.pos.y .. ", z=" .. entry.pos.z .. "},\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    rot = {x=" .. entry.rot.x .. ", y=" .. entry.rot.y .. ", z=" .. entry.rot.z .. "},\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    lock = " .. tostring(entry.lock) .. ",\n"
        if entry.json then
            -- Escape the JSON string for embedding in Lua
            local escapedJson = entry.json:gsub("\\", "\\\\"):gsub("'", "\\'")
            embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    json = [[" .. entry.json .. "]],\n"
        end
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    originalGUID = '" .. entry.originalGUID .. "',\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  },\n"
    end
    
    embeddedData = embeddedData .. "}\n\n"
    embeddedData = embeddedData .. "spawnedClones = {}\n"
    embeddedData = embeddedData .. "fresh = " .. tostring(fresh) .. "\n"
    
    -- Append the embedded data to the script
    script = script .. embeddedData
    
    -- Update the script (instant load like ForceOrg!)
    self.setLuaScript(script)
end

-- Called when the object is loaded (data already embedded in script!)
function onLoad(saved_data)
    -- Data is already loaded from embedded section!
    -- If variables don't exist, initialize them
    if objectJSONs == nil then
        objectJSONs = {}
    end
    if spawnedClones == nil then
        spawnedClones = {}
    end
    if fresh == nil then
        fresh = true
    end
    
    -- Update fresh status based on data
    if #objectJSONs > 0 then
        fresh = false
    end
    
    -- Show appropriate buttons (instant - no JSON.decode!)
    if fresh then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end

--==============================================================================
-- (Data object system removed - objectJSONs stored directly in script_state)
--==============================================================================

--==============================================================================
-- BUTTON CREATION FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

-- Creates the initial Setup button when no objects are in memory
function createSetupButton()
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    self.createButton({
        label = "Setup",
        click_function = "buttonClick_setup",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 1, 0},
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        height = 350,
        width = 800,
        font_size = 250,
        color = {0, 0, 0},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
end

-- Creates the main action buttons (Select Faction, Unselect, Setup)
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    -- Select Faction button (main action)
    self.createButton({
        label = "Select Faction",
        click_function = "buttonClick_selectFaction",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 1, -5},
        rotation = {40, 180, 0},
        height = 350,
        width = 1800,
        font_size = 280,
        scale = {1.3,1.3,1.3},
        color = {1, 0.2, 0.5},
        font_color = {0, 0, 0}
    })
    
    -- Unselect button
    self.createButton({
        label = "Unselect",
        click_function = "buttonClick_unselect",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 0.6, -6},
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        height = 350,
        width = 1050,
        font_size = 250,
        color = {0, 0, 0},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
    
    -- Setup button (to modify saved positions)
    self.createButton({
        label = "Setup",
        click_function = "buttonClick_setup",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 1, 1.2},
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        height = 350,
        width = 800,
        font_size = 250,
        color = {0, 0, 0},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
end

-- Creates buttons during Setup mode
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    -- Cancel button
    self.createButton({
        label = "Cancel",
        click_function = "buttonClick_cancel",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 0.5, -5},
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        height = 350,
        width = 1100,
        font_size = 250,
        color = {0, 0, 0},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
    
    -- Add button - adds selected objects to memory
    self.createButton({
        label = "Add",
        click_function = "buttonClick_add",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 0.5, -4},
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        height = 350,
        width = 1100,
        font_size = 250,
        color = {0, 0, 0},
        font_color = {0.25, 1, 0.25}
    })
    
    -- Only show Update Position and Remove if we already have objects in memory
    if not fresh then
        -- Update Position button
        self.createButton({
            label = "Update Position",
            click_function = "buttonClick_updatePosition",
            function_owner = self,
            position = {0, 0.5, -3},
            rotation = {0, 180, 0},
            height = 350,
            width = 1400,
            font_size = 250,
            color = {0, 0, 0},
            font_color = {0.75, 0.75, 1}
        })
        
        -- Remove button
        self.createButton({
            label = "Remove",
            click_function = "buttonClick_remove",
            function_owner = self,
            position = {0, 0.5, -2},
            rotation = {0, 180, 0},
            height = 350,
            width = 1100,
            font_size = 250,
            color = {0, 0, 0},
            font_color = {1, 0.25, 0.25}
        })
    end
    
    -- Reset button
    self.createButton({
        label = "Reset",
        click_function = "buttonClick_reset",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 0.5, -1},
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        height = 350,
        width = 800,
        font_size = 250,
        color = {0, 0, 0},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
end

--==============================================================================
-- SETUP MODE FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

-- Triggered by clicking the Setup button
-- Enters setup mode where you can box-select objects and use Add/Update/Remove buttons
function buttonClick_setup()
    -- Backup current objectJSONs array
    objectJSONsBackup = duplicateTable(objectJSONs)
    
    -- Clear existing buttons
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    -- Create the setup action buttons
    createSetupActionButtons()
    
    broadcastToAll("Setup Mode: Box-select objects, then click Add/Update/Remove", {1, 1, 1})
end

-- Checks if an object matches something in the backup (by approximate position)
function isObjectInMemoryBackup(obj)
    local objPos = obj.getPosition()
    local tolerance = 0.5
    
    for _, entry in ipairs(objectJSONsBackup) do
        if entry.pos then
            local dx = math.abs(objPos.x - entry.pos.x)
            local dy = math.abs(objPos.y - entry.pos.y)
            local dz = math.abs(objPos.z - entry.pos.z)
            
            if dx < tolerance and dy < tolerance and dz < tolerance then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- Cancel button - restore previous state
function buttonClick_cancel()
    objectJSONs = objectJSONsBackup
    
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    if #objectJSONs == 0 then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    
    broadcastToAll("Setup Canceled", {1, 1, 1})
end

-- Add button - adds currently selected objects to memory
function buttonClick_add(obj, player_color)
    fresh = false
    
    -- Get the player's currently selected objects
    local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
    
    -- Build new objectJSONs array from selected objects
    local newObjectJSONs = {}
    local count = 0
    
    -- Keep existing entries from backup
    for _, entry in ipairs(objectJSONsBackup) do
        table.insert(newObjectJSONs, entry)
        count = count + 1
    end
    
    -- Add new selected objects
    for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
        if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() then
            -- Skip self
            if selectedObj ~= self then
                -- Check if this object is already in memory (by position match)
                local alreadyExists = false
                for _, entry in ipairs(newObjectJSONs) do
                    if positionsMatch(selectedObj.getPosition(), entry.pos) then
                        alreadyExists = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                
                if not alreadyExists then
                    count = count + 1
                    local pos = selectedObj.getPosition()
                    local rot = selectedObj.getRotation()
                    
                    -- Get and store full JSON (like ForceOrg - no originals needed!)
                    local json_data = selectedObj.getJSON(false)
                    json_data = cleanJsonData(json_data)
                    
                    table.insert(newObjectJSONs, {
                        pos = {x = round(pos.x, 4), y = round(pos.y, 4), z = round(pos.z, 4)},
                        rot = {x = round(rot.x, 4), y = round(rot.y, 4), z = round(rot.z, 4)},
                        lock = selectedObj.getLock(),
                        tint = selectedObj.getColorTint(),
                        json = json_data,
                        originalGUID = selectedObj.getGUID(),
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    objectJSONs = newObjectJSONs
    
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    createMemoryActionButtons()
    
    broadcastToAll(count .. " Objects Saved", {1, 1, 1})
    updateSave()
end

-- Update Position button
-- Updates positions of objects currently in memory to their current positions
function buttonClick_updatePosition(obj, player_color)
    -- Get the player's currently selected objects
    local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
    
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    local count = 0
    
    -- For each selected object, update its entry in the backup
    for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
        if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() then
            -- Skip self
            if selectedObj ~= self then
                local pos = selectedObj.getPosition()
                local rot = selectedObj.getRotation()
                
                -- Find matching entry in backup by old position and update it
                for i, entry in ipairs(objectJSONsBackup) do
                    if positionsMatch(pos, entry.pos, 2) then -- Looser tolerance for "same object"
                        count = count + 1
                        -- Update position and rotation
                        objectJSONsBackup[i].pos = {x = round(pos.x, 4), y = round(pos.y, 4), z = round(pos.z, 4)}
                        objectJSONsBackup[i].rot = {x = round(rot.x, 4), y = round(rot.y, 4), z = round(rot.z, 4)}
                        objectJSONsBackup[i].lock = selectedObj.getLock()
                        objectJSONsBackup[i].tint = selectedObj.getColorTint()
                        -- Update JSON and GUID
                        local json_data = selectedObj.getJSON(false)
                        objectJSONsBackup[i].json = cleanJsonData(json_data)
                        objectJSONsBackup[i].originalGUID = selectedObj.getGUID()
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    objectJSONs = objectJSONsBackup
    
    createMemoryActionButtons()
    
    broadcastToAll(count .. " Object Positions Updated", {0.75, 0.75, 1})
    updateSave()
end

-- Remove button - removes selected objects from memory
function buttonClick_remove(obj, player_color)
    -- Get the player's currently selected objects
    local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
    
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    local count = 0
    local newObjectJSONs = {}
    
    -- Rebuild objectJSONs array excluding selected objects
    for _, entry in ipairs(objectJSONsBackup) do
        local shouldRemove = false
        
        -- Check if any selected object matches this entry's position
        for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
            if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() then
                -- Skip self
                if selectedObj ~= self then
                    if positionsMatch(selectedObj.getPosition(), entry.pos, 2) then
                        shouldRemove = true
                        count = count + 1
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        if not shouldRemove then
            table.insert(newObjectJSONs, entry)
        end
    end
    
    objectJSONs = newObjectJSONs
    
    if #objectJSONs == 0 then
        fresh = true
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    
    broadcastToAll(count .. " Objects Removed from Memory", {1, 0.25, 0.25})
    updateSave()
end

-- Reset button - clears all memory and starts fresh
function buttonClick_reset()
    fresh = true
    objectJSONs = {}
    objectJSONsBackup = {}
    spawnedClones = {}
    
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    createSetupButton()
    
    broadcastToAll("Faction Picker Reset", {1, 1, 1})
    updateSave()
end

--==============================================================================
-- SELECT FACTION / UNSELECT FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

-- Select Faction button - creates clones of objects at player-rotated positions
function buttonClick_selectFaction(obj, playerColor, altClick)
    -- First, clean up any existing clones for THIS player only (allows re-selecting)
    deleteClonesForPlayer(playerColor)
    
    -- Spawn clones for this player (objectJSONs already in memory - no loading needed!)
    spawnClones(playerColor)
    
    -- Update the score tracker for this player
    updateScoreTrackerImage(playerColor, CONFIG.FACTION.SCORE_TRACKER_IMAGE)
    
    -- Update the player name on the score tracker (with delay to let reload finish)
    local playerName = Player[playerColor].steam_name or playerColor
    Wait.frames(function()
        updateScoreTrackerName(playerColor, playerName)
    end, 2)
    
    broadcastToAll(CONFIG.FACTION.NAME .. " Selected by " .. playerName .. " (" .. playerColor .. ")", {1, 1, 1})
    updateSave()
end

-- Spawns clones of all objects at player-rotated positions
function spawnClones(playerColor)
    local rotationAngle = getRotationAngleForPlayer(playerColor)
    
    -- Initialize the player's clone tracking table
    if spawnedClones[playerColor] == nil then
        spawnedClones[playerColor] = {}
    end
    
    if #objectJSONs == 0 then
        broadcastToAll("No objects saved in faction picker!", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
        return
    end
    
    -- Spawn all objects from embedded JSON (no originals needed!)
    for _, entry in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
        if entry.json then
            -- Calculate rotated position and rotation
            local rotatedPos = rotatePositionAroundCenter(entry.pos, rotationAngle)
            
            -- Apply rotation adjustment to object rotation
            local rotationAdjustment = rotationAngle
            if rotationAngle == 90 or rotationAngle == 270 then
                rotationAdjustment = rotationAngle + 180
            end
            
            local rotatedRot = {
                x = entry.rot.x,
                y = entry.rot.y + rotationAdjustment,
                z = entry.rot.z
            }
            
            -- Store spawn position for lazy deletion (only used when unselecting)
            table.insert(spawnedClones[playerColor], {
                pos = rotatedPos,
            })
            
            -- Spawn from embedded JSON (no originals needed!)
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = entry.json,
                position = rotatedPos,
                rotation = rotatedRot,
                sound = false,
            })
        end
    end
    
    -- Save immediately (no waiting, no expensive getAllObjects() call)
    updateSave()
end

-- Unselect button - deletes the clicking player's cloned objects only
function buttonClick_unselect(obj, playerColor, altClick)
    -- Delete clones belonging to the player who clicked
    deleteClonesForPlayer(playerColor)
    
    -- Reset score tracker to blank for this player
    updateScoreTrackerImage(playerColor, CONFIG.BLANK_SCORE_TRACKER_IMAGE)
    
    broadcastToAll(CONFIG.FACTION.NAME .. " Unselected by " .. playerColor, {1, 1, 1})
    updateSave()
end

-- Deletes all cloned objects for a specific player
-- Uses lazy position matching to find spawned objects
function deleteClonesForPlayer(playerColor)
    if spawnedClones[playerColor] then
        -- Find and delete objects at the stored spawn positions
        for _, spawnData in ipairs(spawnedClones[playerColor]) do
            -- Find objects near this spawn position
            for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
                if positionsMatch(obj.getPosition(), spawnData.pos, 1.0) then
                    -- Check if it's not self
                    if obj ~= self then
                        obj.destruct()
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        spawnedClones[playerColor] = {}
    end
end

-- Deletes the original objects that were saved in memory
function deleteOriginalObjects()
    local deletedCount = 0
    for _, entry in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
        if entry.originalGUID then
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(entry.originalGUID)
            if obj ~= nil then
                obj.destruct()
                deletedCount = deletedCount + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if deletedCount > 0 then
        print("[FactionPicker] Deleted " .. deletedCount .. " original objects")
    end
end

-- Deletes ALL cloned objects from ALL players (used for reset)
function deleteAllClones()
    for playerColor, spawnDataList in pairs(spawnedClones) do
        for _, spawnData in ipairs(spawnDataList) do
            -- Find objects near this spawn position
            for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
                if positionsMatch(obj.getPosition(), spawnData.pos, 1.0) then
                    if obj ~= self then
                        obj.destruct()
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    spawnedClones = {}
end

--==============================================================================
-- SCORE TRACKER FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

-- Finds an object by its name
function findObjectByName(objectName)
    for _, obj in ipairs(getObjects()) do
        if obj.getName() == objectName then
            return obj
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Updates the score tracker image for a specific player color
function updateScoreTrackerImage(playerColor, imageURL)
    if not playerColor then
        print("[FactionPicker] Warning: No player color provided for score tracker update")
        return false
    end
    
    local trackerName = CONFIG.SCORE_TRACKER_NAMES[playerColor]
    if not trackerName then
        print("[FactionPicker] Warning: No score tracker configured for player: " .. tostring(playerColor))
        return false
    end
    
    local tracker = findObjectByName(trackerName)
    if not tracker then
        print("[FactionPicker] Warning: Could not find score tracker: " .. trackerName)
        return false
    end
    
    -- Get current custom object properties and update the image
    local customObj = tracker.getCustomObject()
    if customObj then
        customObj.image = imageURL
        tracker.setCustomObject(customObj)
        tracker.reload()
        print("[FactionPicker] Updated " .. playerColor .. " score tracker with " .. CONFIG.FACTION.NAME .. " image")
        return true
    else
        print("[FactionPicker] Warning: Could not get custom object properties for score tracker")
        return false
    end
end

-- Updates the score tracker player name
function updateScoreTrackerName(playerColor, playerName)
    if not playerColor then return false end
    
    local trackerName = CONFIG.SCORE_TRACKER_NAMES[playerColor]
    if not trackerName then return false end
    
    local tracker = findObjectByName(trackerName)
    if not tracker then return false end
    
    tracker.call("setPlayerName", {name = playerName})
    return true
end

--==============================================================================
-- PLAYER ROTATION FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

-- Gets the rotation angle for a given player color
function getRotationAngleForPlayer(playerColor)
    if playerColor and CONFIG.SEAT_ROTATIONS[playerColor] then
        return CONFIG.SEAT_ROTATIONS[playerColor]
    end
    return 0
end

-- Rotates a position vector around the center point (0, 0, 0) by the given angle
function rotatePositionAroundCenter(pos, angleDegrees)
    local angleRad = math.rad(angleDegrees)
    local cosAngle = math.cos(angleRad)
    local sinAngle = math.sin(angleRad)
    
    return {
        x = pos.x * cosAngle - pos.z * sinAngle,
        y = pos.y,
        z = pos.x * sinAngle + pos.z * cosAngle
    }
end

--==============================================================================
-- JSON CLEANING FUNCTIONS (from ForceOrg Tile Creator)
--==============================================================================

-- Cleans JSON data by removing unnecessary fields to reduce size
function cleanJsonData(json_data)
    -- Remove empty/default fields to reduce JSON size
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"AltLookAngle":{"x":0.0,"y":0.0,"z":0.0}]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"Nickname":""]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"GMNotes":""]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"LuaScript":""]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"LuaScriptState":""]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"XmlUI":""]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"Value":0]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"LayoutGroupSortIndex":0]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"Sticky":false]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"GridProjection":false]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"HideWhenFaceDown":false]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"Hands":false]], "")
    json_data = json_data:gsub([[,"IgnoreFoW":false]], "")
    
    return json_data
end

--==============================================================================
-- UTILITY FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

-- Checks if two positions match within a tolerance
function positionsMatch(pos1, pos2, tolerance)
    tolerance = tolerance or 0.5
    if not pos1 or not pos2 then return false end
    
    local dx = math.abs(pos1.x - pos2.x)
    local dy = math.abs(pos1.y - pos2.y)
    local dz = math.abs(pos1.z - pos2.z)
    
    return dx < tolerance and dy < tolerance and dz < tolerance
end

-- Finds the offset distance between two positions
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local yOffset = 0
    if obj ~= nil then
        local bounds = obj.getBounds()
        yOffset = (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    end
    return {
        x = (p2.x - p1.x),
        y = (p2.y - p1.y) + yOffset,
        z = (p2.z - p1.z)
    }
end

-- Rotates coordinates based on object rotation
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
    local angle = math.rad(obj.getRotation().y)
    local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
    local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
    return {x = x, y = desiredPos.y, z = z}
end

-- Duplicates a table (shallow copy)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

-- Removes highlights from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

-- Rounds a number to the specified decimal places
function round(num, dec)
    local mult = 10 ^ (dec or 0)
    return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end
